newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nanjing Posts opens at HK$3.98.
newsitem.headline: Nanjing Posts opens at HK$3.98.

text.p: Nanjing Posts & Telecommunications Equipment Co Ltd opened at HK$3.98 on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on Thursday against an offer price of HK$2.43.
The company listed 100 million foreign currency B shares in Shenzhen on Thursday. The shares gained 65 percent in early morning trade, despite a sharp fall in the overall market.
Nanjing Posts was quoted at HK$4 a few minutes after opening, up HK$1.57 or 64.61 percent from the issue price.
Brokers said Nanjing Posts was boosted by recent strong debuts posted by other B share firms.
"Recent B share debuts in Shenzhen were so strong that Nanjing Posts cannot be an exception," an analyst at China Guotai Securities told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.

Shenzhen's B share market recently listed two other newcomers, Wafangdian Bearing Co Ltd and pesticide maker Hubei Sanonda Co Ltd and both of them gained over 70 percent on their debuts, brokers said.
"But Nanjing Posts' gains were limited by today's market, which is suffering from Beijing's new crackdown," another analyst with a major Chinese brokerage said.

Beijing on Wednesday evening announced it would ban state enterprises and listed firms from speculative stock trading, which pushed share prices on the Shenzhen and Shanghai stock markets sharply lower at Thursday's opening.
